# Broad Peak Adventures

> Broad Peak Adventures is a premier, 100% locally-owned mountaineering agency and tour operator based in Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. We specialize in high-altitude Karakoram expeditions, K2 Base Camp trekking, cultural tours, and custom private travel.

## Core Expeditions & Treks

- **K2 Base Camp Trek**: 21 Days, Extreme (5,585m max altitude). Concordia, Baltoro Glacier, K2 Base Camp, Broad Peak Base Camp. Starting at $2,850.
- **Attabad Lake & Hunza Explorer**: 7 Days, Moderate (2,500m max altitude). Attabad Lake, Baltit Fort, Passu Cones, Rakaposhi Viewpoint. Starting at $1,200.
- **Fairy Meadows & Nanga Parbat Base Camp**: 8 Days, Moderate-Hard (3,300m max altitude). Fairy Meadows, Raikot Glacier, Nanga Parbat View. Starting at $1,150.
- **Deosai Plains & Skardu Valley**: 6 Days, Easy-Moderate (4,114m max altitude). Deosai National Park, Sheosar Lake, Shangrila Resort, Shigar Fort. Starting at $980.

## Travel Information & Permits
- **Visas**: E-Visa required for international tourists. LOI (Letter of Invitation) provided for all confirmed bookings.
- **Permits**: NOCs, National Park fees, and trekking royalties handled 100% by Broad Peak Adventures.
- **Safety**: Licensed local mountain guides, satellite phone support on remote routes, and Askari Aviation helicopter evacuation clearance.
